content.text:
**What I decided:** I'm fairly sure, not totally. Harel's fees all look about the same, roughly half a percent. The one that's done best is the "מניות" track, 24.04% over 3 years. After that comes "עוקב מדד S&P 500" at 13.7% over 3 years. That's what I'd look at. But I only saw one of Harel's products. The tab already selected was "קופת גמל להשקעה", which sounds like a pension thing for older people. I didn't see the tracks for my own קרן השתלמות or my pension, so I didn't really see everything Harel offers.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **Screen 1:** big heading "הראל". Then "כל המוצרים של הראל", with buttons: תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים 16, קרן השתלמות 16, קופת גמל להשקעה 16, קרן חדשה מקיפה 19, and a few more. "קופת גמל להשקעה" was the one lit up. Then a row of track buttons (מניות, S&P 500 and so on). Then one line: "16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מההיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%". That's tiny, so all the fees are basically the same.
- **Screen 2, the table:** I read each row from the right: track name, fee, then the return.
  - מניות: 0.55%, 24.04% over 3 years, 14.64% over 5 years.
  - S&P 500: 0.56%, 13.7% and 11.92%.
  - כספי (שקלי): 4.25%.
  - Most rows just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" where the return should be. So no number, nothing to compare.
- **Screen 3:** the הלכה track, 0.61%, 11.42% over 3 years. The small text under the table I skipped. After that came folds: קרנות מחקות, מרכזיות לפיצויים, קרנות סל. I didn't open any of them.
- **Screen 4:** a list of folds under "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל". One of them is "קרן השתלמות 8", but I didn't open it. Then a search box and the footer. That's where I stopped.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "ההפקדה" versus "ההיסכון". There are two fees? The one "מההפקדה" is 0% everywhere.
- "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח": S&P is 99% and 99%. Does that add up to 198%?
- "מט"ח"
- "קופה" with numbers like 15283
- "מרכזיות לפיצויים"
- "תקרה בחוק"
- "PF-10"

**What bothered me:**
- It opened on the wrong product, and I can't see my own קרן השתלמות tracks here.
- It says 16 tracks, but I counted fewer rows. Maybe I scrolled past some.
- Most tracks have no return at all, just "פחות מ־3 שנים".
- I'm not sure whether 24.04% over 3 years is the total or per year. I took it as the total.
- The fees are only in percent, never in shekels, so I can't tell what they cost me.
